name: tank-you-again
description: Tank You Again — server-authoritative 2D top-down multiplayer tank game (TankPit/Battlefield 2006 clone).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
